verdict.rationale: Extensive first-party API v2 docs cover bookings (create/reschedule/cancel), event types (create, scheduling configuration, custom fields), availability/schedules, webhooks, and multiple auth methods (OAuth, API key), matching the story's request for programmatic management of event types, availability, and bookings. Coverage is corroborated by multiple independent doc pages and a probe confirming the docs index is live; missing for 10: no independent third-party developer testimonial of building a product on the API and no public OpenAPI spec (probe found all candidate OpenAPI paths 404).
